title: Assembly and Battle: The Story in the Space
description: Assemble and build the ultimate space craft then take it to battle! A&B Space is a crazy space shooter where every dollar you collect matters! You can use your money to buy and build upgrades for your ship. You can customize everything on your ship from the wings to the chassis to the guns it has equipped! Arm yourself to the teeth and build up huge armored ships! Did I mention it has a sweet story? Good luck, and happy flyin'!
